title: feat(post): add Hurco WinMax (NC) ISNC post and Hurco VM10i machine
body:
Replaces #2640 with the same Hurco commit (`4cd8bdae2`, cherry-picked unchanged) on a branch straight off `main`. #2640 was stacked on the Grbl post draft #2506, so it could not merge before #2506. This PR does not need it.

## Review fix round on `3b5c4da6e` (head `19b688263b94a680de590634bd1461cfd58f3b5f`)

- Merged `upstream/main` (`afca9b8b1`) with a merge commit (`dff9b3870`). The merge had no conflicts.
- Main added `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps` (#4065). With `hurco-winmax.cps`, the posts directory has 27 shipped text posts. `comment_escape::header_notes_use_each_shipped_dialect_and_keep_the_full_surface_bound` now counts 27 (commit `19b688263`).
  - Pin proof: with the count at 26 the test fails (`left: 27, right: 26`). With 27 it passes.
- No post or golden changed in this round.
- Evidence on `19b688263`:
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 862 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (68.1 min).
  - `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: 6 steps, 0 failed (10.9 min).
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
  - `cargo check --tests -p <pkg>`, one package at a time, for `camcraft-post`, `camcraft-app`, `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-sim`, `camcraft-geometry`, `camcraft-tools`, `camcraft-ui`, `camcraft-kernel`, `camcraft-gpu` and `xtask`: all pass.
- Open: the WinMax simulator result of the new kit (review finding 1). The tester has not replied yet.

## Earlier fix round (tester report on #2573 and this PR)

Head: `3b5c4da6e3d4d5476ac570cb1a7ba3d8483bf27d`.

- The tester's WinMax simulator stopped `DRILL1.NC` at `G43 H562`.
- Default output now writes no `G43 H` line. The control takes the tool length from the Tool Setup screen.
- The new option `toolLengthOffset` (default off) writes `G43 H<tool>` after each `T M6`. With the option on, a tool number outside 1..200 is refused by name. Hurco gives the `H` range as `H00` to `H200`. That is the probable cause of the `G43 H562` alarm.
- The new option `retractAlongToolVector` (default off) writes `G00 M140` at the end of each operation. After it, the next X/Y traverse states its Z first.
- The new option `shortestRotaryPath` (default off) writes `M126` after the start line and `M127` before `M30`.
- Tool pre-fetch (`T110 M6`, then `T104`): Hurco confirms the behaviour. It is not added here. Follow-up #4113 gives the two reasons:
  - the post cannot find the next tool, because `programTools` is sorted by number;
  - with "M6 Initiates Tool Change" set to No, a bare `T` word changes the tool at once.
- Merged `upstream/main`. The conflicts were in registry lists only (`posting_files.rs`, `conformance.rs`, `machine.rs`), where both sides added lines. Both sides are kept.
- After the merge, main's #3442 law (`radius_arcs`: `major_arcs_use_negative_r_and_degenerate_arcs_fall_back_to_ijk`) found a Hurco defect. An inch arc of r=0.001 mm wrote `G03 X0. Y0. I0. J0.`, which a control reads as a full circle. `onCircular` now asks `arcFate` (PRELUDE) first, as the other shipped posts do. The gate run before the fix failed this test, and it passes after the fix. `comment_escape` now counts 26 shipped text posts.
- Merge fallout in the Hurco tests is fixed: `ProgramId.notes`, `OpParams` fields `picks`, `blend_radius`, `chain_overrides`, `corner_relief` and `pass_start`.

## Hurco sources

Each fact is from Hurco's own documents, in our own words.

- **Hurco WinMax Mill NC Programming online help, "Tool and Radius Offsets (G40-G49)"** (support.hurco.com, `.../NC_Programming/Tool_and_Radius_Offsets_(G40-G49).htm`):
  - When the program has no `G43`/`G44` and no `H` word, the control uses the tool length from the Tool Setup screen.
  - A `G43`/`G44` offset overrides the Zero Calibration length of Tool Setup.
  - The `H` offset code range is `H00` to `H200`. `H00` or `G49` cancels the offset.
  - The offset table on that page shows that in `G49` mode the total offset is the Tool Setup Zero Calibration value. Thus the safe start line keeps `G49`.
- **Online help, "Program Functions"** (`.../NC_Programming/Program_Functions.htm`):
  - "M6 Initiates Tool Change": when this parameter is Yes (the default), a `T` word without `M06` pre-fetches the tool. When it is No, a `T` word alone changes the tool.
  - "Change Tool (M06)": the new tool's Tool Setup offsets load at the change.
  - `M126`/`M127`: the shortest rotary angle path traverse, and its cancel.
  - `M140 [L_] [P_]`: a non-modal retract along the tool vector. Without `L`, the tool retracts to the machine limits.
- **Online help, "Miscellaneous Functions - M Codes"** (`.../NC_Programming/Miscellaneous_Functions_-_M_Codes.htm`): the index lists `M31`, `M126`/`M127` and `M140` as current WinMax M codes.
- **Hurco WinMax Mill NC Programming manual, 704-0116-310 (2010)**:
  - page 4-1, "T Codes": a `T` word does not change the tool by itself. It pre-fetches the tool when "M6 Initiates Tool Change" is Yes.
  - page 5-13: `M126`/`M127` work only on the VMX42 SR.
  - page 5-19: `M140` works only on the VMX42 SR.
  - The current online help does not have these two machine limits. The tester's 2019 WinMax uses `G0 M140` after each operation. Thus the two codes are options, default off.
- **Hurco WinMax Mill documentation (2008)**: not cited for this round. No fact in this round comes from it.

## What changed

- Add clean-room built-in post `Hurco WinMax (NC)` in `assets/posts/hurco-winmax.cps`.
- Add clean-room 3-axis VMC definition `Hurco VM10i` in `assets/machines/hurco-vm10i.mch`.
- Register both entries in `BUILTINS`, `MACHINES`, and `embedded()` in `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs`.
- Write Hurco WinMax ISNC blocks:
  - the `G20`/`G21` unit block and `O0001`..`O9999`;
  - `G90 G17 G94 G54..G59 G40 G49 G80` and `G54.1 P1`..`P93`;
  - decimal-second `P` dwell on `G04`/`G82`/`G89`;
  - `G84.2`/`G84.3` rigid tapping and `G84` floating tapping;
  - `G68`/`G69` rotation and `G31` probing with `G10 L2`;
  - no `G91.1`, and no `G43 H` by default.
- Opt-in options `toolLengthOffset`, `retractAlongToolVector` and `shortestRotaryPath`, all default off.
- Record design decisions in `docs/decisions/2573-hurco-winmax-post.md`.

## Tests

- Pins for this round, in `crates/post/tests/hurco_winmax_metadata.rs`:
  - `hurco_default_writes_no_g43_h_and_no_opt_in_m_codes`: the default writes `T562 M6` and no `G43`, no `H`, no `M126`/`M127`/`M140`.
  - `hurco_tool_length_offset_option_writes_g43_h_and_refuses_out_of_table`: the option writes `G43 H109` and `G43 H4`, and refuses tool 562 by name (`H01..H200`).
  - `hurco_m140_and_m126_options_write_their_blocks`: one `G00 M140` for each operation, `M126` at the start, `M127` before `M30`, and Z before X/Y after `M140` with the same tool (no tool change).
- Mutations. Each pin was RED with the mutation and GREEN when restored:
  - default `toolLengthOffset` forced on: `hurco_default_writes_no_g43_h_and_no_opt_in_m_codes` fails.
  - `H` range guard raised from 200 to 9999: `hurco_tool_length_offset_option_writes_g43_h_and_refuses_out_of_table` fails.
  - `xyUnknown = true` after `M140` removed: `hurco_m140_and_m126_options_write_their_blocks` fails.
- `crates/post/tests/hurco_winmax_post.rs`: the multi-op test now asserts no `G43 H` by default. The word allow-list adds `M126`, `M127` and `M140`.
- Suites run on this head:
  - `camcraft-post`: `hurco_winmax_metadata` 4 passed, `hurco_winmax_post` 8 passed, `hurco_winmax_probe` 2 passed, `script_hurco_winmax` 11 passed.
  - `camcraft-app`: `conformance` 7 passed, `hurco_winmax_post`, `machine`, `post_spindle_rule_all` passed.
  - `camcraft-app` example catalog: `example_catalog` 43 passed (4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work` passed.
- Gate and lint on this head:
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` on `3b5c4da6e`: 856 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (64.3 min). The run on the earlier head `df96d22b9` had 2 failures (`comment_escape`, `radius_arcs`). Commit `3b5c4da6e` fixes both.
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` on `3b5c4da6e`: 0 warnings, exit 0.
- Heavy lanes: `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` on `3b5c4da6e`: 6 steps, 0 failed (6.2 min). The full heavy lanes were not run. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches 71 release steps. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" says that no PR runs the full heavy lanes, and that a `P6` PR gets no heavy step. Those lanes run at the cut.

## Goldens moved

Regenerated with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_hurco_winmax` and `WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-app --test conformance`.

- Removed the `G43 H<n>` line after each `T<n> M6` (this round's default change):
  - `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/hurco-winmax/`: `contour_disc_hole`, `contour_plate_with_hole`, `contour_tangential_lead`, `drill_peck`, `drill_plate`, `face_square_40x40`, `face_square_40x40_stepped`, `pocket_waterline_plate_with_island`, `slot_fullwidth_centerline`, `tap_plate`, `trace_plate_with_hole` (`.nc`).
  - `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/synth_hurco-winmax.nc`.
  - `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/hurco-winmax/`: `arcs`, `drill_retract`, `extreme_coords`, `full_circle`, `full_circle_raw`, `probe` (`.nc`).
- Also moved by toolpath changes on `main` (the same programs moved for each other dialect on `main`), with the `G43 H` line removed:
  - `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/hurco-winmax/pocket_zigzag_plate_with_island.nc`
  - `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/hurco-winmax/slot_wide_channel_rows.nc`
- No golden of another post changed. No `.cl` and no `examples/catalog/**` file changed.

## Not exercised

- No WinMax simulator result for this head yet. A new 3-program kit is in a PR comment. It asks the tester to run `DRILL1.NC` again.
- The options `retractAlongToolVector` and `shortestRotaryPath` are not checked on a Hurco control. The VM10i is 3-axis, so `M126`/`M127` have no rotary axis to act on.
- `G43 H` with the option on is not checked on a control.
- No UI change, so no screenshots.

Changelog: Add built-in Hurco WinMax (NC) ISNC 3-axis mill post and Hurco VM10i machine. The post takes the tool length from Tool Setup (no `G43 H`) by default, with opt-in `G43 H`, `M140` and `M126`/`M127`.

Fixes #2573
